summary: Iteration 10 - Tested unified Add Property flow with OTA import. All 10 features working correctly: (1) Single Add Property button opens choice modal, (2) Choice modal has Sync from OTA and Add Manually options, (3) Sync from OTA opens import dialog with name/source/URL fields, (4) POST /api/ota/import-property creates property and imports bookings, (5) After OTA import edit dialog opens immediately, (6) Add Manually opens manual form, (7) Manual form save works, (8) GET /api/properties/{id} returns single property, (9) Sync from OTA button shows when feeds_count > 0, (10) Imported bookings show OTA source badges on Bookings page.
passed_tests: ✅ POST /api/ota/import-property - creates property and imports bookings
✅ GET /api/properties/{id} - returns single property by ID
✅ GET /api/properties/{id} - returns 404 for invalid ID
✅ GET /api/ota/sync-status - returns feeds_count > 0 after import
✅ GET /api/bookings - imported bookings have ota_source, ota_external_id, ota_feed_id
✅ POST /api/properties - manual property creation works
✅ PUT /api/properties/{id} - property update works
✅ OTA feeds created automatically after import
✅ Import from different sources (airbnb, vrbo, booking.com, expedia)
✅ Invalid URL handling (returns 500 as expected)
✅ Authentication endpoint working
✅ UI: Properties page shows 'Add Property' button
✅ UI: Add Property opens choice modal with two options
✅ UI: 'Sync from OTA' choice shows with globe icon and description
✅ UI: 'Add Manually' choice shows with edit icon and description
✅ UI: OTA import dialog has property name, source select, iCal URL fields
✅ UI: OTA import dialog has 'Generate Mock URL' button
✅ UI: OTA import creates property and opens edit dialog immediately
✅ UI: Success toast shows 'Property created with X bookings!'
✅ UI: Manual add form has all property fields (rooms, location, owner details)
✅ UI: Sync from OTA button visible when feeds_count > 0
✅ UI: Bookings page shows OTA source badges (airbnb, vrbo, booking.com, expedia)
✅ UI: Properties show 'Last synced' timestamps and 'Imported from' notes
seed_data_creation: Created test admin user with company. Imported properties via OTA: Test Beach House (airbnb), Test Mountain Cabin (vrbo), City Apartment (booking.com), Beach Villa (expedia), Playwright Test House (airbnb). 22 bookings imported total.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 verified unified Add Property flow: (1) Single 'Add Property' button opens choice modal, (2) 'Sync from OTA' imports property+bookings from iCal URL, (3) After import, edit dialog opens immediately, (4) 'Add Manually' shows traditional form. Mock URL format: mock://source/PropertyName. Backend endpoint: POST /api/ota/import-property. All features from iteration 9 (OTA Settings, feeds CRUD, sync) still working.

unified_add_property_flow.choice_modal: Two options: 'Sync from OTA' and 'Add Manually'
unified_add_property_flow.ota_import: Creates property + OTA feed + imports bookings from iCal
unified_add_property_flow.post_import: Edit dialog opens immediately for user to add details

mocked_apis.details: iCal feeds use mock:// URL format for testing. Mock URLs return generated VEVENT data with random guest names and check-in/check-out dates.
